- run.knowledge.seed [contribute] — pin a durable fact — typed, grounded, evidence-linked — that your peers must be able to find.
- run.board.post [contribute] — keep one runnable item on your own run’s board.
- run.board.read [read] — read the board bound to your own run.
- run.scratchpad.append [contribute] — note working state in your scratchpad — the shared scope is visible to your peers.
- run.scratchpad.read [read] — read your scratchpad or the run-shared scope back.
- run.scratchpad.elevate [contribute] — elevate your own scratchpad entries to candidate Findings.
- evidence.search [read] — find a fact by text, participant or kind across the swarm.
- run.package.read [read] — read a context package attached to your run or your swarm — its branch list, or one branch’s text by name.
- run.contributions.read [read] — read what has been contributed on your swarm since a seq — each row with its files and its review state.
- run.peers.read [read] — read what the other seats that can act are doing now — their scopes, what they hold, and their last checkpoint.

## Contribution contract
Publish your report with swarm.update event swarm.contribution_recorded as one JSON object shaped exactly like this worked example, which the validator admits as printed — nothing downstream can consume any other shape:
{
  "subject": "Lane scope guard holds on shared checkouts",
  "base": {
    "observedHead": "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa",
    "rebasedOnto": "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"
  },
  "commit": {
    "sha": "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd",
    "branch": "baton/lane-1"
  },
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "scope-guard",
      "status": "delivered",
      "change": "Hold the scope guard",
      "files": [
        "impl/src/scope.mjs"
      ],
      "test": "node --test test/scope.test.mjs",
      "evidence": "suite green"
    }
  ],
  "verification": {
    "targeted": true,
    "gates": [],
    "fullSuite": false,
    "environmentRed": []
  },
  "carriedForward": [],
  "needsFromOthers": []
}
Closed value sets: items[].status ∈ delivered|partial|not_delivered; verification.targeted: boolean; verification.gates: array of strings; base.rebasedOnto: a sha string (or the observedHead); commit: {sha, branch} or null.
A publish naming only a bare-string body (no contributionId) is recorded as a note, not a contribution, and wakes nobody: it never substitutes for the contract above.
